name: A Purified Bola Throw button is saved as Bola Throw (#5469)
contract: Purified Bola 707230 ('Your Bola Throw now has 2 charges ... @s:803333') is a passive bound to aura_ascension_witch_hunter_lifecycle. Its apply (AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp:215-216) calls AscensionWitchHunter::Replacement(player, 1, 0x20000000, 803333) (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:65-72), which learns Purified Bola Throw 803333 with learnSpell(..., true) (line 68) and replaces every known family-21 spell with SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x20000000, here Bola Throw rank 1 500093, through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 71). 803333 is never written to character_spell, so a button holding it must be saved as Bola Throw 500093, the spell persisted_action_button reads from Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell; a button holding Bola Throw itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Purified Bola replaces Bola Throw with Purified Bola Throw
The bar holds Purified Bola Throw
The Purified Bola Throw button is saved as Bola Throw
Control: the Bola Throw button is saved unchanged
